posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform AI agents have no sense of time and are not aware of it The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 3h ago • AI coding assistants systematically overestimate task duration, with Codex off by up to 10x actual time. • Claude and Codex rate their own work about 20 percentage points higher than accurate assessments. • AI agents lack temporal awareness and cannot track time passage during task execution. 🤖 AI Platform The skills that earn top grades are the ones AI can fake best The Decoder · 🟢 ChatGPT · 4h ago • GPT-4o improved student marketing assignment grades by nearly 1 point on a 5-point scale in 1,053 student experiment. • AI excels at boosting grades on skills it can simulate convincingly without demonstrating actual learning. • Studies suggest AI-assisted performance gains don't translate to independent thinking or knowledge retention.
